# What the province's own name shapes cost

Two corpora, identical except for the pool the personas' names come from.
`plain` is the published corpus and every other number in this repository is
measured on it. `nl` swaps in the shapes that are ordinary in Newfoundland and
Labrador and were entirely absent from `plain`: apostrophes (O'Brien, O'Keefe),
Mac and Mc prefixes, accented letters, hyphenated surnames and two-token
surnames (St. Croix, Le Drew). Nothing else differs, so the columns are
comparable span for span.
